g.text: py-app-event-sign-glow-bestemming | type event-sign | trim 297 x 420 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: 22 printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: Tekengebied_1.pdf p1, Tekengebied_4_kopie_4.pdf p1 (CMYK; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 297 x 420 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 303 x 426 mm.

Variabelen: background-colour = #1A3580; destination-1 = Philips stadion; arrow-1 = left; state-1 = inactive; destination-2 = Evoluon; arrow-2 = pin; state-2 = active; destination-3 = TD-gebouw; arrow-3 = left; state-3 = inactive

A3 297 x 420 mm, no bleed in the source (background is exactly the trim), template adds 3 mm bleed. Navy background is the token #1A3580 (the source GLOW blue is CMYK 100/84.4/5.5/0.4, viewer #174797). White P is py-atom-symbol-p-plain scaled from 91.7 to 173.44 mm; Parkeren is Ubuntu Bold 35.28 mm. GLOW is the third party mark

(reference only, source the official file). Pills: route = three active pills (Philips stadion arrow left, DLL arrow up, TD-gebouw arrow up); bestemming = Evoluon active with pin, Philips stadion and TD-gebouw inactive (25 percent, arrow left in print). Print arrows differ from the library arrows, see py-comp-pill-destination. Source details: the DLL label

has a trailing space in the file (DLL and a space), label centres are set by eye per pill, pill pitch measured 51.61 and 51.41 mm (template uses 51.5). Variables: destination-N, arrow-N (left, up, pin), state-N (active, inactive).
